name: BAR-ROCK
author: keste
description: A polyphonic harpsichord for VIBE FM: 16 allocation-free Karplus-Strong voices, two slightly detuned 8' choirs, a two-pole soundboard, fixed-memory stereo reverb and a bar-fly-derived colour rack with solid/tube distortion, clean-room dual-rotor Leslie, phaser, chorus, flanger, tremolo, auto-pan, ring mod, lo-fi crush and ping-pong/tape echo. Sixteen registrations carry FX scenes, pads 1-16 select them, F3/PLAY plays a 12-second Dido snippet, and raw MIDI note on/off works. No samples, no impulse responses, no heap.
